description: A file a chat message carries, staged at upload and claimed at send (P3-65, design §3.2). Written by the server only. Project staff read Sent rows and their own uploads; clients read none.

fields.label: Message
fields.description: Empty while the upload waits to be sent.

fields.label: State
fields.description: Held (P3-71): an upload waiting on a file request item, with no expiry; never sent, purged or drawn as a card.

fields.label: Source
fields.description: Upload: sent from a device. Copy: a checked copy of a project file (Share and send, D-390). Link: a project file linked, never copied or shared.

fields.label: File
fields.description: Set at send for an upload or a copy; the linked file for a link. Data, never a Link: a File is deleted or binned on its own, and the card then looks like a deleted file (rule 2).

fields.label: Source File
fields.description: The project file a copy was made from; never shared by the copy. Data, never a Link: a File is deleted or binned on its own, and the card then looks like a deleted file (rule 2).

fields.label: Kind
fields.description: photo, pdf, office, drawing, model or file (design §15.6).

fields.label: Content Hash
fields.description: Of the bytes sent (R-32, §15.3): a card shows the revision that was sent.
P3-75: pending, ready, failed or skipped; empty before the previews row
fields.label: Preview State

fields.description: What the card shows without a picture (IFC: schema and app), as JSON
fields.label: Preview Meta

fields.description: P3-75 (D-417): a large file waits for its background virus scan; it cannot be sent until clean
fields.label: Being Checked

fields.description: P3-75: background scans that could not run (clamd down); refused after scan_holds.MAX_TRIES
fields.label: Scan Tries

fields.description: P3-75: why a held upload was refused (threat, could_not_check); it cannot be sent
fields.label: Scan Reason
Taken On
fields.description: The capture time only; the place is never kept (L-16).

fields.label: Staged
fields.description: The waiting bytes, outside the site's files (D-389).
P3-67 (design §3.6): a voice note's length in seconds, read by the server from the container, never the browser's
fields.label: Voice Length

fields.description: P3-67 (SEC-16): the audio type detected from the bytes (audio/mp4, audio/ogg, audio/webm)
fields.label: Voice Type

fields.description: P3-67: the waveform the browser sent at the send, checked for count and range, as JSON
fields.label: Voice Waveform
